headline: Stlican Shelf Flares Anew; Godcrofts Wreck Leaves the Map
war_summary: The chief change since our last edition lies on Stlican Shelf, which has flared from quiet into the day's busiest field: thirty-nine flag actions, two inside the final two hours, The Pale House again taking the worst of it with eighteen blows, and one work there now stands demolished — the first new ruin since the Godcrofts wreck passed from the map. Godcrofts itself furnishes the freshest fighting on the board, four actions in the last two hours and three Colonial captures logged in the day, the field now split six Warden works to three. The Dead Lands still bears the heaviest butcher's bill, some 20,500 casualties in twenty-four hours with the Warden share larger, Callahan's Boot struck fifteen times. Weathered Expanse, twenty-two actions, has cooled; Stonecradle's grind about The Cord and The Long Fast goes on, eleven blows in six hours. Callahan's Passage bleeds on without a flag change. The board reads 265 works to the Colonials, 170 to the Wardens, one in ruin. It is the 170th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
